provenance: #238 lane C · 2026-09-02 · licence receipt for R1 family fam-robustness (R1 row 30). Tier vocabulary is R1's own (safe now / pointer-only); every tier here is PROPOSED, not ruled.

family.name: RFC 9413 — Maintaining Robust Protocols (the IETF/IAB walk-back of Postel's robustness principle)
family.steward: IETF Trust (copyright); Internet Architecture Board (stream); authors M. Thomson, D. Schinazi
family.grade_context: R1 grade D-as-inoculation for Postel's Law; enters as an INOCULATION node under s237-D3

primary_source.what_it_is_our_words: The RFC itself. Its Copyright Notice names the licence: BCP 78 plus the IETF Trust Legal Provisions in effect on the publication date (June 2023). The RFC's header says 'Stream: Internet Architecture Board (IAB)', and the TLP treats IAB-stream documents differently from IETF-stream ones — that difference is the whole tiering question for this family.
primary_source.walkback_receipt_le_15_words: is no longer considered best practice in all scenarios
primary_source.walkback_locus: RFC 9413 §2, of the interpretation 'that advocates for tolerating unexpected inputs'
primary_source.approval_note_le_15_words: The document had broad but not unanimous approval within the IAB
primary_source.approval_locus: Appendix 'IAB Members at the Time of Approval'

fetches.http_as_demonstrated: content returned; WordPress 6.0.10; title 'Corrected Legal Provisions Relating to IETF Documents'
fetches.size: NOT MEASURED — full TLP 5.0 text, Sections 1-9, effective March 25, 2015, corrected September 21, 2021 (name of the BSD licence only)
fetches.probe_for_licence: Sections 3 (licences), 3.d (licences not granted), 6.b (notices) and 8 (alternate streams, incl. 8.c.iii and 8.e IAB stream) read in full — this IS the licence text

fetches.size: NOT MEASURED — the full RFC: header, abstract, status, Copyright Notice, sections 1-8, appendices
fetches.probe_for_licence: header block: Stream IAB, Category Informational, June 2023. Copyright Notice: 'Copyright (c) 2023 IETF Trust and the persons identified as the document authors. All rights reserved.' + 'subject to BCP 78 and the IETF Trust's Legal Provisions … in effect on the date of publication'. The notice is the Alternate-Stream form of TLP 6.b.ii (no Code Components sentence). No 6.c.i/ii derivative-works limitation legend is present.
'Current TLP: Corrected Trust Legal Provisions 5.0' — so TLP 5.0 is the version in effect at June 2023 and today

licence.name: IETF Trust Legal Provisions 5.0 (corrected), applied to an IAB-stream document via TLP §8.e — with §8.c.iii lifting the standards-process limit
licence.read_from: the licence text itself (TLP 5.0) + the RFC's own Copyright Notice and stream header
licence.quote_le_15_words: copy, publish, display and distribute IETF Contributions and IETF Documents, in whole or in part
licence.quote_locus: TLP §3.a.i — the grant that §8.c.iii applies to Alternate Stream documents without the 'as part of the IETF Standards Process' limit
licence.second_quote_le_15_words: shall not be limited to the IETF Standards Process
licence.second_quote_locus: TLP §8.c.iii, of the §3.a grant for Alternate Stream documents
licence.third_quote_le_15_words: without the required legends and notices described in these Legal Provisions
licence.third_quote_locus: TLP §3.d.ii — the licence that is NOT granted: publishing portions without the notices
licence.grants_our_words: For this IAB-stream RFC: copy, publish and distribute it in whole or in part; translate it; and (no limiting legend being present) modify or prepare derivative works — none of it confined to the standards process.
licence.forbids_our_words: Publishing or distributing any portion without the IETF legends and notices (§3.d.ii is not lifted by §8.c.iii). No patent licence (§5.a). Third-party copies are not 'definitive' (§7.e).
licence.reading_note_our_words: For an IETF-stream RFC the answer would be narrower: full unmodified copies, or attributed unmodified portions, and no derivative works outside the standards process (§3.c, §3.d.i). The stream header is what widens it here. This lane's reading of §8.c.iii is a reading of the text, not a legal opinion; it is flagged below.

permits_us: reproduce — verbatim, in whole or in part, carrying the RFC's copyright notice and an attribution to IETF/RFC 9413; paraphrase — permitted on this lane's reading of §8.c.iii for an IAB-stream document (flagged); at minimum, attributed unmodified quotation is safe under the narrower IETF-stream reading
why_our_words: The one family whose licence turns on a header field. R1 wrote 'IETF / IAB' as the steward and that slash is doing legal work: the IAB stream gets the wider §3.a grant. Even on the narrow reading an inoculation node can quote the RFC's own sentences with the notice attached, which is all an inoculation node needs — Postel's rule cited, the IAB's words beside it.
cheap_route_to_lift: Not needed. If Dave wants the §8.c.iii reading confirmed: the TLP page names trustees@ietf.org for additional-rights requests (§3.e). Price: one email.
unproven: That §8.c.iii's lifting of the standards-process limit means a commercial third party may prepare derivative works of an IAB-stream RFC — this is a plain reading of the text by this lane, not counsel's opinion. The attributed-unmodified-quotation posture does not depend on it. Price: one email to trustees@ietf.org, or counsel.

pitfalls.what: A generator that reads 'RFC' and applies the familiar IETF-stream rule (no modification) will under-use this family; one that reads 'Alternate Stream' and drops the notices breaches §3.d.ii. The notice string must travel with every emitted portion regardless of reading.
pitfalls.owner: generator's licence/attribution field — a per-family 'notice text' slot

pitfalls.what: R1's register says 'IETF / IAB' but the licence hinges on the stream; a source-register field 'stream' (or an equivalent 'edition/variant' field) would make this mechanical for the other RFC-class families that may enter later (RFC 1958, RFC 760 are cited inside 9413).
The RFC records 'broad but not unanimous approval'. An inoculation node that presents the walk-back as settled overstates its own source.
